content: In all the taking out and reinserting these screws I noticed that spade connector was disconnected.  Make sure to check that the spade terminal is connected to the female wire
Don't overtighten the M3x6.  I think it's going straight into plastic

replies.content: yep.... it is... lol i messed that up too
Too late, seems like I stripped it! Will that cause any issues later? Perhaps I should find my LocTite and put a little on the screw..

The M3x6 screw is mainly used to pre-secure the motor mount during the initial assembly, so it is not as critical at this stage of the upgrade. However, we'll add a warning not to overtighten it, as it goes directly into plastic.
